timeline.label: Tag
timeline.visual: Logo animation or brand mark reveal. Clean. Minimal.

timeline.label: Loop
timeline.visual: Product or lifestyle montage. 3-4 shots. Brand world visuals.

timeline.label: Reveal
timeline.visual: Hero product reveal. Slow mo. Light flares.

timeline.label: CTA
timeline.audio: Loop fades to tag. Memory imprint.

sound_direction: Brand sound pack applied throughout: 3s tag at open, 15s loop during montage, reveal sound at product moment, tag reprise at close.
export_notes: 1080p, 9:16, H.264. Logo must be clear in first and last frames. Sound is the hero — visuals support the audio identity.
client_usage: Replace visuals with your brand assets. Replace text with your brand copy. Use YOUR Brand Sound Pack. This template IS your sonic identity in video form.
